hero.subtitle: Six consultation services, delivered by ADP's bilingual team and backed by our managed SOC partner ecosystem.

challenge.title: The frameworks we work against
challenge.body: Each framework applies to a different set of entities and asks for different evidence. We work against all of them, from NCA ECC for government and critical infrastructure through to PDPL, ISO/IEC 27001 and SAMA's framework for banks.
points: NCA ECC, CCC, DCC, OTCC and CSCC
PDPL (SDAIA), for all entities processing personal data in the Kingdom
ISO/IEC 27001, for organizations seeking a certified ISMS
SAMA CSF, for banks and SAMA-regulated financial institutions

opportunity.title: One lifecycle, from first assessment to continuous compliance
opportunity.body: Every compliance engagement follows one lifecycle: assess, prioritize, remediate, certify and monitor. The final step, monitoring, is where compliance becomes a continuous managed service. The Saudi cybersecurity market is forecast to grow from USD 2.9B in 2025 to USD 7.5B in 2034.

capabilities.title: Governance & Compliance
capabilities.body: NCA ECC, CCC, DCC, OTCC and CSCC readiness; PDPL; ISO/IEC 27001 implementation and certification support.

capabilities.title: Risk & Gap Assessment
capabilities.body: Control-by-control gap analysis, risk register and a prioritized, costed remediation roadmap.

capabilities.title: Offensive Security
capabilities.body: Vulnerability assessment and penetration testing, application security testing and red-team exercises.

capabilities.title: Security Architecture
capabilities.body: Zero-trust, cloud and network security design; OT/ICS segmentation and secure remote access.

capabilities.title: vCISO & Security Program
capabilities.body: Virtual CISO, policies and procedures, awareness programs and board-level reporting.

capabilities.title: SOC & Incident Readiness
capabilities.body: SOC design and onboarding, incident-response playbooks and tabletop exercises.

applications.title: NCA ECC
applications.body: For government entities and critical national infrastructure: gap assessment, remediation roadmap, policy set and self-assessment support.

applications.title: NCA CCC
applications.body: For cloud service providers and cloud consumers: cloud security posture review, control mapping and provider due diligence.

applications.title: NCA DCC
applications.body: For entities handling classified and sensitive data: data classification, protection controls and watermarking.

applications.title: NCA OTCC
applications.body: For operators of OT/ICS environments: OT asset inventory, segmentation design and OT monitoring.

applications.title: PDPL (SDAIA)
applications.body: For all entities processing personal data in the Kingdom: data mapping, privacy impact assessments and records of processing.

applications.title: SAMA CSF
applications.body: For banks and SAMA-regulated financial institutions: maturity assessment and remediation program.
